title: Belmont track and field teams earn USTFCCCA All-Academic honors for 2025-26 season
text:
Belmont track and field teams earn USTFCCCA All-Academic honors for 2025-26 season
Belmont University Track & Field programs received All-Academic Team recognition from the U.S. Track & Field and Cross Country Coaches Association for the 2025-26 season, according to an announcement in July.
The Belmont men's team achieved a 3.29 cumulative team grade-point average during the academic year. This GPA represents the team's cumulative average over their collegiate careers for all student-athletes listed on the NCAA squad for both indoor and outdoor seasons. The women's team also met eligibility requirements, posting a collective GPA of 3.63.
To qualify for the USTFCCCA All-Academic Team award, teams must maintain a cumulative GPA of at least 3.0 on a 4.0 scale throughout the academic year.
Both Belmont men's and women's teams have been included on the USTFCCCA's All-Academic roster in 13 of the last 14 seasons. In previous years, individual athletes such as Tyra Finkeldey and Madelyn Quinn have earned All-Academic Athlete honors by maintaining at least a 3.25 GPA after two semesters at Belmont and meeting athletic performance criteria.
Student-athletes seeking individual recognition must finish ranked among the top performers nationally or regionally in their events or participate in any round of NCAA Division I Championships.
